map.name: Fort Ostkar
map.setting: a frozen fort on a mountain pass
map.trouble: The warlock Kragan and his Trolls hold the Upper Gate at the top of the pass, and no one can cross the mountains.

guard_bark.specifics: Tolvar, the guard at the fort's main gate.

first.speaker: Tolvar
first.text: Aren't you supposed to be off fighting Trolls?

again.speaker: Tolvar
again.text: There is a smithy right behind Brannoc's hall.

later.speaker: Tolvar
later.text: I've been ordered not to leave the wall.

bounty_offer.specifics: Haskel the goatherd wants the White Wolves of the Howling Crag killed after they raided the goat pens.

offer.speaker: Haskel
offer.text:
Damn! Where were you, lad!? The White Wolves came down on the goat pens and we'd have lost every last goat to them if Tolvar's archers hadn't opened fire from the wall at the final moment!

But in all the confusion, the pack dragged off half my herd, leaving a smashed fence the least of my worries! The whole fort will starve this winter if the herd is lost!

You must go where the pack ran off to, west to the Howling Crag! Kill those wolves or we are finished!

reminder.speaker: Haskel
reminder.text: I'm sure those wolves will be back for more! Hurry!

completion.speaker: Haskel
completion.text:
In better other days, the whole fort would feast in honor of the slaying of that pack! Well done, lad! But now we must stop the wicked Kragan once and for all.

Here, accept these as a token of my thanks for your brave deed!

journal.text: Climb the Howling Crag and kill the White Wolves.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Osk the healer lost his healing staff to the Imps that overran the cellars under his infirmary.

offer.speaker: Osk
offer.text:
Where were you all this time!? We have a dreadful problem!

Overgrown bats and screeching Imps from deep inside the mountain have overrun the cellars under my infirmary. Good men have bled in defense of the fort's precious stores!

And one of those Imps flew off with my healing staff! Please, I beg of you! Get my staff back from the beasts and you'll be handsomely rewarded.

This key opens the cellar door behind the infirmary. The Imps' nest lies somewhere beyond.

I also have a potion which might prove quite handy. Will you help me?

refusal.speaker: Osk
refusal.text: Very well. I suppose the wounded must suffer without it, then.

reminder.speaker: Osk
reminder.text: Come back to me once you have my staff and I'll pay you as promised.

completion.speaker: Osk
completion.text:
You are a true hero! A thousand thanks.

While you were down in the cellars, fighting the Imps, Brannoc came by, asking after you. He wants to see you in the Keep -- at the top of the hill.

Before you leave, please take this gold for your efforts.

after.speaker: Osk
after.text: Brannoc is a fine Warden. You'd do well to heed his counsel.

journal.text: Clear the Imps from the infirmary cellars and recover Osk's staff.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Clear the Imps from the infirmary cellars and recover Osk's staff.

rumour.specifics: Three townsfolk: Tibbet, Gorm and Fenna.

rumour1.speaker: Tibbet
rumour1.text: We must drive out Kragan! Smash his Trolls and take back the Upper Gate.

rumour3.speaker: Fenna
rumour3.text: There is a good inn next to Haskel's goat pens.

shop_greeting.specifics: Bornik the innkeeper, Gribb the smith, Zell of the magic shop.

inn.speaker: Bornik
inn.text: I trust you won't need a bed here for long, stranger. You look like someone with plenty left to do.

arms.speaker: Gribb
arms.text: Pssst! Hey! Pal! Need a sword? Lowest price in the pass and they're forged right here in Fort Ostkar!

two_givers.specifics: Brisa begs for her husband Pell, taken by the Trolls from the woodcutters' camp. Tibbet needs his uncle Gorm's lucky helm back from the Trolls before Gorm gets home.

offer_a.speaker: Brisa
offer_a.text:
Kind sir! Please help me! A band of Kragan's Trolls just raided the woodcutters' camp, the camp below the fort and carried off nearly every cutter! One of them is my dear husband, Pell!

Please bring him home and I swear you'll be rewarded!

offer_b.speaker: Tibbet
offer_b.text:
The Trolls just made off with my uncle's lucky helm! If it isn't back by tonight, he'll have my hide. He's due home off the wall any time now!

Please, help me, young sir! I think the Trolls who grabbed it went to the old chapel.

Would you... could you fetch it back for me?

outcome_a.speaker: Brisa
outcome_a.text: Oh, bless you, brave Adventurer! Please take these as tokens of my gratitude!

outcome_b.speaker: Tibbet
outcome_b.text: Phew! Thanks a lot! Here, take this as a token of my appreciation!

journal_a.text: Rescue Pell and the woodcutters from Kragan's Trolls.

journal_b.text: Recover Gorm's lucky helm from the Trolls at the old chapel.

rescue.specifics: Tolvar sends the player after Hobb, the Master Builder, trapped in the Lower Vaults when the lift froze.

plea.speaker: Tolvar
plea.text:
While you were up on the battlements, the old lift froze in its shaft -- trapping Hobb in the Lower Vaults far beneath the fort! Brannoc is worried sick for our Master Builder.

We best get down under the fort and find Hobb.

reminder.speaker: Tolvar
reminder.text: Why are you standing about? We must hurry to the lift shaft! Hobb could be freezing to death!

found.speaker: Hobb
found.text:
Hey, it's you! The one Thrane sent!

There are some awfully big spiders down here. I had to bar myself in while I was patching the vault walls.

Here's the key. Go back around to the barred door.

following.speaker: Hobb
following.text: Thanks again. There ought to be potions in that crate. Come on, stay close! I know an old stair that comes out by the Keep!

completion.speaker: Tolvar
completion.text:
Thank goodness you're both safe! You'd make a fine sentry of Ostkar, lad. Brannoc will be pleased you brought his Master Builder home in one piece.

Here, take this Ankh for your trouble.

journal.text: Rescue Hobb from the Lower Vaults beneath Fort Ostkar.

main_opening.specifics: Fenna points the player to Brannoc, Warden of Fort Ostkar, who sends him to the Signal Tower against Kragan.

herald.speaker: Fenna
herald.text: Aiiieee! Trolls! Trolls! Run to Brannoc!

opening.speaker: Brannoc
opening.text:
Greetings. I am Brannoc. The Warden of Fort Ostkar. Thrane writes that you are the one to break Kragan's hold on the pass. The warlock sits behind the Upper Gate, guarded by his brutish Trolls.

You must climb to the Signal Tower and speak to the lookouts. Take this key. It opens the postern door that leads up to the tower.

reminder.speaker: Brannoc
reminder.text:
Kragan must be driven out! YOU are the one Thrane trusts to open this pass.

Go now! The snows will not wait.

journal.text: Speak to the lookouts in the Signal Tower.
